name: Build a Brainrot Factory
desc:
🏭 Welcome to Build a Brainrot Factory!

How to Play:
🛠️ Buy machines to produce brainrots
⬆️ Place upgraders to increase the value of brainrots
👷‍♂️ Lead the brainrots through your factory using conveyors
💰 Collect your earnings and repeat

Want to Advance:
♻️ Rebirth your data to gain higher multipliers
🔓 Unlock more advanced machines to product better brainrots
🏗️ Combine machines together in the crafting machine

👍 Like the game and join the group for a bonus!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
